title: QuickDeathMods
description: Best modern PvP pack with FPS boost and clean visuals for recording.
body:
QuickDeath__
 BEST MODERN FPS BOOST PACK 
Experience smooth gameplay, clean visuals, and optimized PvP performance with this modern-style pack! Designed for competitive players who want maximum FPS and a stylish look at the same time. Perfect for Bedwars, Skywars, Duels, and all PvP modes.

 Features:
• Ultra Smooth FPS Boost
• Clean Modern UI & Textures
• Low Fire & Clear Particles
• Optimized for PvP Combat
• Better Visibility in Fights
• Custom Swords & Armor
• Minimal Lag Experience
• Perfect for Low-End PCs

This pack is also perfect for recording and content creation! 🎥
It gives smooth FPS, clean visuals, and a modern look that makes your gameplay videos look better and more professional. Great for YouTube recordings, montages, PvP clips, and streaming without lag
